consentModal.title: Enable Location Services
consentModal.description:
We'd like to show you content relevant to your area.

We will:
• Detect your city and state
• Show local Israeli community content
• Cache your location for 24 hours

We will NOT:
• Track your exact location
• Share your location with third parties
• Store your location permanently without consent

You can change this anytime in settings.

badge.tooltip: Real-time audio processing delay. Video is automatically delayed to match for perfect sync.

components.captureDesc: Time to capture audio from video

info.autoSyncDesc: Video is automatically delayed to match audio processing time, ensuring perfect lip-sync and subtitle timing.
info.howItWorksDesc: The system measures actual processing latency and delays the video stream by the same amount. This is how professional broadcast translation works.
info.noManualAdjustmentDesc: Unlike other systems, you don't need to manually sync audio and video. Everything is automatic.
info.whyDelayDesc: Real-time translation and dubbing takes time (typically 600-800ms). Rather than showing out-of-sync content, we delay the video to match. You see content slightly behind 'live' but perfectly synchronized.
info.professionalQualityDesc: This is the same approach used by professional broadcasters for live international coverage.
